Select IC50 activity rows for the human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records and docs to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
